items.title: A smooth morphism is etale-locally a projection from an affine space
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter morphisms.tex (Morphisms of Schemes)
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file morphisms.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a morphism which is smooth at a point becomes, after passing to an affine open neighbourhood of the point inside the preimage of a given affine open of the target, a composite of an etale morphism with the projection from an affine space. The statement carries a slogan summarising this local structure. The proof uses the characterisation of smoothness at a point through the standard smooth presentation, writes the coordinate ring of the chosen affine open as a quotient of a polynomial algebra over the base by the standard smooth equations, and then exhibits the projection to an affine space together with the induced etale morphism described by the presentation.
